{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Dev''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Pls Donate]] as part of the [[Tower Defense Simulator x PLS DONATE Event]]. It had a high amount of health, quite high defense and also an average speed. It was [[Freeze Immunity|Freeze Immune]] and [[Stun Immunity|Stun Immune]]. ==Appearance== The '''Dev''' had pale skin. It wore a black shirt with a white Roblox logo, black pants and shoes. It had a yellow and blue construction helmet and it had a hammer in its right hand. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Engineer]] or [[Mercenary Base]] are quite useful against this. *As it has quite high defense, defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be effective against this. **As it has [[Freeze Immunity]], freeze defense dropping towers cannot be used. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} DevWalk.gif|Walking animation (13 November 2024 – 4 December 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} PLS DONATE Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Dev''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} NoobFace.png|'''Dev's''' face. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy's name is a shortening of the word developer, as this enemy is based on Roblox developers. **It wore the {{RLinkC|1080951|Builders Club Hard Hat}} on its head. *The '''Dev''' originally had a slightly different appearance. It was significantly larger, bigger than the [[Breaker4]], it had a different shirt and walked differently. ==Update History== *'''13 November 2024''' - [[v1.41.0]] **'''Dev''' added. **{{Bug}} [[Jester]]'s defense dropping does not reduce '''Dev's''' defense. *'''4 December 2024''' - [[v1.44.0]] **'''Dev''' removed. {{PlsDonate|[[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]]|Wave 13|Dev & [[Alien (Pls Donate)|Alien]]|Wave 15 (Easy)|hardt2 = Dev, [[Alien (Pls Donate)|Alien]] & [[Breaker4]]|hardw2 = Wave 15 (Hard)|[[UFO (Pls Donate)|UFO]]|Wave 16}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
